dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Progressive, symmetrical reduction in 2D width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are largely smooth, though a slight asymmetrical inward curvature is visible on the left posterior margin at the peduncle transition.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity is a uniform light grey, categorized between slate-grey and mature white, with high-intensity specular highlights along the central axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced, linear dorsal ridge along the midline, characterized by a distinct longitudinal specular highlight.
